motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus feedback, color and border shifts. Ease-out-quart.

motion.name: transition-med
motion.purpose: Default state transitions on cards, buttons, the tab underline.

breakpoints.name: card-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Session grid reflows: cards are minmax(min(100%, 640px), 1fr). Below this a card spans full width. The product is desktop-first; there is no mobile layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-outline action: Run, Add, Save, primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 8px 18px; color: var(--accent); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 14%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/quiet action: Edit, Remove, Cancel. Remove hovers to Signal Red.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--text-dim); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-head); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. Focus shifts the border to orchid, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text-head); background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container on the canvas. Border lifts on hover; no resting shadow. Never nest cards.
components.html:
api-server

One Claude Code session bound to one project.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px 28px; color: var(--text); transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text-head); } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: Session state. Color plus glyph plus shape, so state never relies on hue alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--state-running); background: transparent; } .ds-badge .ds-badge-glyph { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Primary view tab. Active tab draws an orchid underline that scales in, never a layout shift.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; appearance: none; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-head); padding: 6px 10px 8px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="false"] { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: center; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="false"]::after { transform: scaleX(0); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Attention Callout
components.description: Amber attention block for a real blocker (setup needed). Each file is an open-in-editor button. Full border plus tinted fill, never a side-stripe.
components.html: Setup needed: fill this project's pack, then run.
components.css: .ds-callout { padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-waiting) 32%, var(--border)); border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-waiting) 7%, var(--bg-surface)); font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; } .ds-callout-head { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-callout-files { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-callout-file { font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 11px; color: var(--text-dim); background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-callout-file:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Minimized Session Cards
components.description: Collapsed dock chips. State rides border color plus a dot, not badges. RUNNING is steady green; WAITING is loud amber. Color-blind safe by hue, saturation, and motion.
components.html: api-serverdb-migrateworker
components.css: .ds-mini-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-mini { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 120px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; opacity: 0.85; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-mini:hover { opacity: 1; border-color: var(--border-hover); } .ds-mini-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-dim); opacity: 0.45; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-mini-name { flex: 1; text-align: center; color: var(--text-head); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mini[data-state="running"] { opacity: 1; border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-running) 55%, transparent); } .ds-mini[data-state="running"] .ds-mini-dot { background: var(--state-running); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-running) 25%, transparent); } .ds-mini[data-state="waiting"] { opacity: 1; border-color: var(--state-waiting); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-waiting) 12%, var(--bg-card)); } .ds-mini[data-state="waiting"] .ds-mini-dot { background: var(--state-waiting); }

components.name: Permissions Badge
components.description: Skip-permissions warning chip. Full 1px border (it replaced a border-left stripe), amber-orange, tinted fill.
components.css: .ds-perms { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 6px; line-height: 18px; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--perms-warn); border: 1px solid var(--perms-warn); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--perms-warn) 16%, transparent); }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Header overflow menu. Lifted off the plane with shadow-lg. Items have a mono-safe glyph column; danger variant recolors to Signal Red.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 180px; padding: 4px 0; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-hover); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in oklab, #c084fc 15%, oklch(0.06 0 0)) 65%, transparent); font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 6%, transparent); color: var(--text-head); } .ds-menu-item-danger { color: var(--state-failed); } .ds-menu-item-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-failed) 10%, transparent); color: var(--state-failed); } .ds-menu-glyph { display: inline-block; width: 1.2em; text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-menu-item:hover .ds-menu-glyph { color: inherit; } .ds-menu-divider { height: 1px; margin: 4px 8px; background: var(--border); }

components.name: Settings Tabs
components.description: Tab strip inside the settings dialog. Active tab takes orchid text plus a 2px orchid bottom border riding the strip divider. Distinct from the primary view tabs (uppercase, no animated underline).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: 'Cascadia Code', monospace; } .ds-tab-pill { padding: 6px 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tab-pill:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-tab-pill[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); } .ds-tab-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Glissa is a machine intelligence watching its constructs through the night. The surface is deep oil-black tinted toward violet; a single iridescent orchid accent is the only chromatic voice in the chrome. State surfaces as cold, exact glints, only when something actually changes. The console is precise, unsentimental, and a little uncanny: it never blinks and never raises its voice. Everything is monospace, density is welcome where it pays for itself, and chrome recedes so the terminal output (the real product) holds the eye. It rejects the generic AI-SaaS dashboard, the IDE clone, the toy aesthetic, and the corporate committee look.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-forward: one typeface family carries headings, labels, data, and body.
Oil-black violet surfaces with one iridescent accent used sparingly.
Flat by default; depth comes from tonal layering and 1px borders, never resting shadows.
Color and motion are reserved for genuine state signals.
Compressed type scale (10px to 16px); hierarchy from weight, tracking, color, and case, not size.
Four shipping themes (Phyrexian default); colors read from CSS variables so the system is theme-agnostic.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Iridescent Orchid is the only accent, used on roughly 10% of any screen or less. Its rarity is the point. Never introduce a second decorative hue.

rules.name: The Earned Signal Rule
rules.body: A state color that means nothing teaches the operator to ignore it. State color appears only on a real state change, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure black, no pure white. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand violet.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: The type scale is deliberately compressed (10px to 16px). Build hierarchy with weight, tracking, color, and case, not larger sizes.

rules.name: The Monospace Voice Rule
rules.body: UI text is monospace. Do not introduce a sans or serif for body, labels, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow or glow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, elevation off the plane, or a live status).

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are violet-tinted near-black, never raw rgba black.

dos: Do keep Iridescent Orchid (#c084fc) to ~10% of any screen. One voice, used rarely.
Do carry state with a glyph plus shape plus color, never hue alone.
Do speak in monospace (Cascadia Code) for all UI text, and build hierarchy from weight, tracking, color, and case rather than size.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; convey depth with the canvas/card/surface tonal ramp and 1px borders.
Do reserve glow and motion for genuine state changes.
Do tint every neutral toward violet; use Bright Lavender White (#e8e0ff), never #fff, and Near-Black Violet (#0a0810), never #000.
Do give every interactive element a visible 2px orchid focus ring with offset; the tool is keyboard-first.
Do let the terminal output be the loudest thing on screen; chrome recedes.
donts: Don't build the generic AI-SaaS dashboard: no gradient hero, no rounded glass cards, no purple-to-blue gradient, no Inter.
Don't make it look like a VS Code or IDE clone. Glissa is a monitor, not an editor.
Don't use a children's or toy aesthetic: no cartoonish rounded-everything, no primary-color palette.
Don't fall back to safe corporate enterprise design (IBM-blue committee look).
Don't use gradient text. Emphasis comes from weight and color.
Don't use glassmorphism or decorative blur. Surfaces are opaque.
Don't apply a side-stripe accent (border-left/border-right > 1px as a colored stripe). Use full borders, background tints, or a leading glyph.
Don't give resting surfaces a drop shadow, and never a raw rgba(0,0,0) shadow.
Don't add a second decorative accent hue, or spend a state color on anything that is not that state.
Don't reach for a modal when an inline or progressive disclosure will do.
